title: Grateful Dead Live at Winterland Arena on 1974-10-19
lineage: Nakamichi CR-7A > Tascam DA-3000 (DSF 1-bit/5.6MHz) > Tascam Hi-Res Editor > Samplitude Pro X6 > 24-bit 96 kHz FLAC
source: Sony ECM-22P mic (mono) > Sony TC-55 > Maxell UD C-90 cassettes

ai_review.summary: Excellent audience recording captures a fantastic, surprise‑filled show.
ai_review.review: The reviewer raves about stumbling upon this gem on a cold, rainy night, calling the audio “great AUD” and praising the performance as fantastic. The audience source delivers clear, enjoyable sound that lets listeners soak in the concert’s vibe.

ai_rating.rationale: A single 5‑star review highlights both an excellent audience recording and a fantastic show, leading to a high rating but limited data for confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewer notes the AUD is great—clear enough to be enjoyable despite being an audience capture.
